content:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — metering: token-count drift detected on eu1 ingestion pipeline. Symptoms: delayed usage emits, intermittent overage flags. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/metering-drift. severity: P1. team: eng-sre + billing-sre.

sarah: I'm on call, taking ownership. Starting investigation now. @mike can you look at kafka consumer lag for usage-events?

mike: checking... `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group metering-eu1` shows usage-events-shard-3 lag 2,312,890, others normal. Restarting consumer pod now.

mike: restarted pod metering-consumer-3 (eu1). logs show repeated `OffsetOutOfRangeException` then recovered. tail:
```
2026-03-20T00:12:03Z offset out of range for partition 3
2026-03-20T00:13:10Z consumer rejoined, resumed at offset 12482345
```

jordan: pausing scheduled reconciler backfills to avoid double counts while ingestion catches up.

billing-sre: customer impact: overage flags fired for ~12 accounts (mostly trial/startup tier). Recommend muting automated overage alerts until counts stabilize. @lisa can you hold customer-facing alerts?

lisa: Notifying CSMs for top 12 impacted, sending template note. Will escalate if any urgent billing disputes.

sarah: Lag is decreasing — currently ~420k and falling. Estimated time to clear ~35-50 minutes. Keeping canary monitors on.

mike: temporarily applied dedup window of 30s in metering pipeline to reduce false duplicates (config patch `metering.dedupe.window_s=30`). Monitoring for regressions.

sarah: Handoff: night oncall @oncall-rotation will take over at 02:00 UTC. I'll post a runbook step summary and create incident issue for postmortem. Next update in 15m. :thumbsup:

oncall-rotation: taking handoff at 02:00 UTC. noted mitigation steps and will monitor until catch-up complete.

incident-bot: Pager resolved -> condition cleared. Auto-close suppressed pending incident issue creation.
